text:
alex: quick note — support saw a double charge when a stream resumed to a different shard and the model truncated a toolcall mid-retry. anyone familiar with resume/provisional leaks?
sam: can you paste the req id & short logs? need to know provisional vs confirmed counts.
alex: req_20260321_5: provisional=48 on host A, resume->host B final ack=156, toolcall_truncated=true.
maria: sounds like provisional on A was never released/claimed; host B created a new confirmed charge. ledger needs join keys.
jen: console idea: show provisional allotment in the request waterfall and flag route mismatches so support can see origin host.
ops-bot: Incident INF-3410 created: "resume-truncate possible double billing" assigned eng-platform.
sam: plan: add x-resume-session header, emit provisional_id, provisional_route, toolcall_truncated=true on ledger events. will push router change today.
maria: analytics: once those fields exist we can run a join to detect confirmed overlaps; propose conservative manual-review rule first.
jen: feature-flag the UI row (enable_provisional_view) while QA runs.
alex: action items: sam (headers+telemetry), jen (UI row behind flag), maria (queries & reconcile rules). post traces here.
sam: reprobed locally and uploaded trace trace_20260321_local_1.
maria: if results show >1% of high-volume accounts impacted, finance wants an audit path — we should prepare a support playbook.
alex: thanks team — let's reconvene after the telemetry lands.
